summary: RE-VERIFIED Iteration 14 fix on /app/frontend/app/shared/pauses.tsx — ParentPinModal is now correctly wired for both create and delete flows. End-to-end mobile viewport (390x844) test: papa@demo.fr / demo1234 logged in → Réglages → 'Pauses & congés' (testID=link-pauses) opens /shared/pauses. Selected Léa, filled Du=2026-08-27 / Au=2026-08-28, tapped 'Mettre en pause' (testID=pause-save) with no cached parent_pin_token → ParentPinModal (testID=parent-pin-modal) appeared → entered PIN 1234 → flash '✅ Pause enregistrée' → new pause row visible under 'Pauses actives / à venir' (Léa · jeu. 27 août 2026 → ven. 28 août 2026). Then cleared parent_pin_token from localStorage and tapped testID=pause-del-<id> → ParentPinModal re-opened → PIN 1234 → flash '🗑️ Pause supprimée' and the row disappeared. Cleanup verified: 0 remaining pause-del testids in the DOM. requirePin() + pending-action retry pattern behaves identically to tasks-admin.tsx. No regressions observed.

critical_code_review_comments: pauses.tsx now mirrors tasks-admin.tsx exactly: hasPinToken() pre-check + requirePin(pendingFn) that stashes the action and re-invokes it on ParentPinModal.onSuccess. Also handles post-401 fallback (storage.del + requirePin) inside doSave/doRemove — good defensive path for expired tokens.

Minor (non-blocking): DateField web variant is a plain TextInput ('AAAA-MM-JJ'); if a parent leaves it empty or malformed they only see the save-time flash '❌ Choisis les dates de début et de fin'. Fine for MVP.
The PIN modal is rendered inside the SafeAreaView after the ScrollView which is correct — no scroll interception observed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — create + delete via PIN modal both succeed

seed_data_creation: One TEST pause (Léa · 2026-08-27→2026-08-28) was created during the test and deleted at the end. Final /pauses list is clean (0 rows).
